page.overview:
Who is Audience Researcher?

The audience researcher is the man who was enlisted when the ratings The Itchy & Scratchy Show were unremarkable. He recruited several children and attempted to figure out what they wanted out of the series. They confused him and the rest of Roger Meyers, Jr.'s studio by approving of both realistic and fantastical situations, but Lisa Simpson explained that they were merely tired of always watching the same thing.
